'''Melsa Dor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Dor was a crewmember aboard a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was involved in evacuating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]] during the [[Battle of Argul]]. The [[Argullian]] merchant [[Turyit]] attempted to bribe her into letting him bring some barrels of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] with him aboard the transport. However, she saw that they were being watched by the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawans]] [[Olge Plavi-Dol]] and [[Wamtra]], so she declined his offer and hurried back to work.
